newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heiferswere steady.
Wk to date - 93,800 Week Ago - 113,500 Year Ago - 82,300
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 64.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 62.50. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 64.00, pen North Plains 64.50.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 1,300 slaughter steers and 2,200 heifers; Week to date 93,800 which includes 34,500 formulated and 600 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
